history.description: Added nine graphs and33 observed edges for P.abyssi,T.kodakarensis and C.glutamicum ATCC13032 using inspected primary text,figures and selected supplements. Six hash-bound ledgers and two OPEN discussions retain current N/C-terminal family boundaries,tail-deletion differences,mutation frequency versus rate,and conflicting3/5-nt product assignments. Baseline8296 records had zero drift. Partial coverage remains IN_PROGRESS; no universal DSB-to-HR chain,publication or family-wide completion is claimed.

record.description: Endonuclease NucS cleaves both 3' and 5' ssDNA extremities of branched DNA structures and it binds to ssDNA [[cite:PUB00060574],[cite:PUB00052724]]. This entry represents the C-terminal domain of NucS.

evidence.explanation: Compare original product assignments and later primary evidence. Differences are possible explanatory variables, not an established cause. Ishino deltaCter removes five residues; Takemoto Cdel removes two.
